name: spaceship
description: A small science-fiction fighter: a lifting-body hull with a dark spine and accent stripes, a bubble cockpit (+Z) over a seat, side intakes, swept wings with a cannon at each tip, two engine nacelles with glowing nozzles (pivot at the throat) and canted fins, nav lights, RCS blocks, a sensor dome, and three landing legs hinged at the hull that it stands on (y = 0).
